name: AppleCare At Home Advisor (Canada)
summary: Apple's At Home Advisor remote support role has had Canadian postings in the past, but none were found open in Canada now.
whatYouDo: At Home Advisors troubleshoot Apple devices and services for customers from home, working independently without in-person supervision (per Apple's FAQ for another country).
appeal: Apple's FAQ (Singapore) says At Home Advisors are Apple employees, part- or full-time
Well-known employer if a Canadian posting reappears
watchOuts: Canadian French AHA posting and College Program AHA posting both show as no longer available
Current Canadian AppleCare listings seen are retail-channel roles (Calgary/Winnipeg, 25 h/week), not at-home
An older Apple Community thread reports being told there was no at-home program in Canada
Unofficial look-alike pages on unrelated domains advertise 'Apple Home Advisor Canada' jobs; apply only via jobs.apple.com
applicationSteps: Periodically search jobs.apple.com (Canada) for 'At Home Advisor' or AppleCare
Ignore offers from other sites or messaging apps claiming to hire for Apple
fitsIf: You want to watch for a future Apple remote support opening in Canada.
